description: This file implements an Android activity demonstrating clipboard operations such as copying text, HTML, intents, and URIs. It includes UI components for selecting clip types, displaying clip data, and reacting to clipboard changes.

classes.name: ClipboardSample
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating clipboard functionalities, including copying different data types and displaying current clipboard content.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up clipboard listener, and UI components.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes clipboard listener to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: pasteIntent
methods.description: Copies an intent to the clipboard.

methods.name: pasteUri
methods.description: Copies a URI to the clipboard.

methods.name: updateClipData
methods.description: Updates the UI to reflect the current clipboard contents and selected data type.
